voice: ElevenLabs eleven_v4, Jack - Deep Dark Horror Narrator (BVPhWQykET1TSvfGzrUr), English, one take, split into lines, inner pauses capped at 0.32 s, atempo 1.0

lines.text: We set the ball down on the third floor. Nobody touched it.
lines.beat_before: hook: infrared, the third-floor corridor; the ball starts rolling away from us by itself

lines.text: Waverly Hills Sanatorium. Louisville, Kentucky. A hospital for tuberculosis.
lines.beat_before: the ball rolls on into the dark; cut to the building on its hill at night

lines.text: Before there was a cure, thousands of patients died here.
lines.beat_before: cut to the open-air porch: the ball rolls along it, past the open windows

lines.text: The bodies went down a tunnel under the hill, five hundred feet long, so the living wouldn't see them leave.
lines.beat_before: cut to the tunnel: walking down the long steps

lines.text: Ghost stories say sixty-three thousand died. The records point to far fewer. Still, thousands.
lines.beat_before: from behind, the ball comes bouncing down the steps, past us, into the dark

lines.text: Investigators bring a ball up here. They say a little boy plays with it. They call him Timmy.
lines.beat_before: the third-floor corridor; the ball rolls ahead of us

lines.text: No record of him has ever been found.
lines.beat_before: the ball turns into a ward room; we follow; it stops against a bed frame
silence; the ball rolls back across the room and stops at our feet
